findings.title: Id lookup does not trim the reference, unlike title lookup
findings.why: The plan says `resolve` first looks for a task whose id equals the trimmed ref. `find` calls `byId(titleOrId)` with the untrimmed string and trims only for the title lookup. So `find(' t1 ')` or `complete(' t1 ')` reports not-found, or matches a task titled `t1` instead of the task with id `t1`. Titles are trimmed, so ids should be too.
